scripts.build:native: pnpm --filter @yadaw/dsp-node build && pnpm --filter @yadaw/audio-host-client build && cargo build -p yadaw-audio-host --release && cargo build -p yadaw-vst3-host --bin yadaw-vst3-probe --release && cmake -S . -B target/vst3-bridge-build -DSMTG_ENABLE_VST3_PLUGIN_EXAMPLES=OFF -DSMTG_ENABLE_VST3_HOSTING_EXAMPLES=OFF -DSMTG_ENABLE_VSTGUI_SUPPORT=OFF && cmake --build target/vst3-bridge-build --config Release --target yadaw-vst3-bridge
scripts.check: pnpm format:prettier:check && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm check:rust && pnpm -r --if-present check && pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:unit && pnpm --filter @yadaw/project-db test:integration
scripts.check:rust: pnpm format:rust:check && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm test:rust && pnpm bench:rust:check
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --workspace && cargo test -p yadaw-dsp-node --features bench-internals --test realtime_allocations
scripts.bench:rust:check: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals --no-run
scripts.bench:rust: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals
scripts.bench:rust:quick: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --quick
scripts.bench:rust:save: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --save-baseline main
scripts.bench:rust:compare: cargo bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench native_render --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --baseline main
scripts.test:vst3-fixtures: cmake -S . -B target/vst3-fixtures -DYADAW_BUILD_VST3_FIXTURES=ON && cmake --build target/vst3-fixtures/third_party/vst3sdk/public.sdk/samples/vst/again --config Debug --target again && cmake --build target/vst3-fixtures/third_party/vst3sdk/public.sdk/samples/vst/note_expression_synth --config Debug --target note-expression-synth && cmake --build target/vst3-fixtures --config Debug --target yadaw-vst3-probe yadaw-vst3-bridge yadaw-vst3-smoke && cargo build -p yadaw-audio-host && pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:vst3-helper
